item_short_desc: Rothco’s Cree LED Headlamp is the perfect hands-free flashlight for tactical personnel, cyclists, and avid outdoorsmen.
description: Rothco’s Cree LED Headlamp is the perfect hands-free flashlight for tactical personnel, cyclists, and avid outdoorsmen. The headlamp light features a 2-watt Cree center LED bulb, three ½-watt LED bulbs, and three light modes: high for maximum visibility, low, and red light for navigating through the darkness while conserving your night vision. While setting up a tent, fixing a wire, or performing other tasks, the rotating head allows you to adjust the light in the direction of your work. With a lightweight design and a stretchy adjustable headband, Rothco’s tactical helmet light fits most adult head sizes and doesn’t weigh your head or helmet down. Requires 3 AAA batteries (not included).
